definitions.ask: Off macOS, should Cmd+Enter on a reading task open the PDF in the system default viewer?
definitions.why: Highlights is the annotation source bob ref scan reads; other viewers never sync

choices.label: Show a "Highlights is macOS-only" notice; nothing opens
Open the PDF in the system default viewer instead

definitions.ask: Should Cmd+Enter anywhere inside a managed reference note open that note's PDF?
definitions.why: Matches the request and keeps built-in Cmd+Enter on links inside ref notes

choices.label: Only reading-task, managed-embed, v1-tracker, and Task Link lines open the PDF
Any ref-note line opens its PDF; Cmd+Enter on links there stops opening new tabs
